method: Two complete product blocks per pilot, six arms in 308.5 s; double complete measured work for formal two blocks plus one installation/setup/cleanup, allow variation. This is a pilot-based planning range, not a deadline or confidence interval.
adapter_changes_after_pilot: Guard native session binding at held boundary using existing calibrated checker; same pilot raw passes offline
Retain fixture write errors instead of traceback; no change to response semantics
Capture full failed native history CLI stdout/stderr; startup UNAVAILABLE remains an observation, not failed task
Refuse service execution if dedicated cgroup unavailable
Separately retain observer-parent and HTTP-consumer CPU; native boundaries and fault behavior unchanged
blind_review: Questions frozen before formal start; one isolated automated investigator; no human review claim
